page.layout: One printed page, no margin notes. Full-width introduction at top; then a passage of salutations with two columns of names (left column, then right column); then further salutations and names in full-width lines below; the dedication closes at the foot right. No running head, page number, catchword or signature.

main_text.l: In Mscriptis HENRICI BULLINGERI, Summi Theologi,
Antistitis Ecclesiae Tigurinae, ZUINGLII, Primi Reformatoris, Successoris,
in Praefatione Confessionis Helveticae haec leguntur:

l.i: Omnes Ecclesiae Ministri (sunt verba Synodi Generalis, Ministro-
rum Ecclesiarum Hungariae) qui in conventu Sancto[?] ad 24. Febr. Anno
Domini 1567. Debrecinum convocato, cui & ultra Tibiscum, inter reliquas
Confessiones recepimus, & subscripsimus Helvetica Confessioni, Anno 1566.
edita, cui & Ecclesiae Genevensis Ministri subscripserunt, &c:

page.notes: The library stamp "STADT-BIBLIOTHEK ZUERICH" at lower left is omitted. "Sancto" is set as "Sanéto" in the scan; read as Sancto with [?]. "Doctoi i" appears to be a printing error, left as printed. "Illustriss." and the line breaks of the name block are reconstructed from the layout. Greek "μαθητῇ" is copied as read. The "Ut et" line and the "Item" line are set larger and centred in the scan; kept as paragraphs as salutation and list word.
